items.title: An Agentic AI Pipeline for an Evidence-Grounded Environmental Health Public Information System: Development and Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Existing environmental and health information systems typically provide isolated data streams, requiring users to interpret heterogeneous information sources without personalized guidance. Residents and health providers of urban regions with complex environmental conditions, such as the Salt Lake Valley, frequently seek timely, location-specific information about weather, air quality, and their associated health impacts, but may find it difficult to integrate this information in their decision-making, precluding the effective translation of valuable environmental health information into action. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline that delivers evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses to health-related environmental questions raised lay persons by dynamically orchestrating authoritative weather, neighborhood-scale environmental observations, air quality, and health-evidence resources. Methods: We developed an agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and OpenAI large language models to interpret natural language queries, select and invoke relevant external tools, retrieve real-time environmental data and evidence-based health guidance, and synthesize responses. The pipeline integrates multiple authoritative resources, including weather forecasts, air-quality observations, geospatial services, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module built from asthma-related clinical guidance. The system incorporates fallback mechanisms to improve robustness when external services are unavailable. We evaluated the pipeline using a curated benchmark of representative user questions, assessing tool-needed recognition, correct tool selection, avoidance of irrelevant tools, parameter mapping, analytic pathway selection, and incorporation of tool outputs into the final response. Results: The developed system successfully integrated heterogeneous environmental and health information sources into a unified conversational interface that produces evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses for the Salt Lake Valley. Evaluation demonstrated generally strong tool recognition, parameter mapping, and incorporation of retrieved information across diverse question types, supporting the pipeline's ability to retrieve and integrate authoritative environmental and health information consumable by lay persons and providing an important step for the T3 and T4 phases of the translational pipeline of exposure health informatics. Conclusions: By combining existing environmental health knowledge with local sensor observations and neighborhood-scale environmental measurements, and authoritative state and national weather and air quality resources, the system delivers more localized and context-aware guidance than approaches that rely on authoritative regional or state-level information. Rather than depending on the internal knowledge of a large language model, the pipeline dynamically retrieves, synthesizes, and attributes evidence from authoritative sources. The modular architecture enables seamless integration of additional environmental data streams, health knowledge sources, and geographic regions, providing a scalable foundation for future translational pipelines, completing the T3 to T4 path for environmental health.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】提出并评估一个由 LangGraph 和 OpenAI 大语言模型驱动的 agentic AI 管线，用于整合天气、空气质量、地理空间和健康证据，生成 Salt Lake Valley 邻域尺度的环境健康问答。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把实时环境数据与检索增强健康证据连接起来，并在工具识别、参数映射和结果整合等环节进行基准评估；系统表现支持其作为转化环境健康信息学基础设施的潜力，但尚非临床疗效验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：现有环境与健康信息系统通常提供彼此孤立的数据流，要求用户自行解释异质信息来源，且缺少个性化指导。对于 Salt Lake Valley 等环境条件复杂的城市地区，居民和卫生保健提供者经常需要及时获取关于天气、空气质量及其相关健康影响的地点特异性信息，但可能难以将这些信息整合到决策中，从而妨碍有价值的环境健康信息有效转化为行动。目的：本研究旨在开发并评估一条 agentic artificial intelligence (AI) 管线，通过动态编排权威的天气、邻域尺度环境观测、空气质量和健康证据资源，为普通民众提出的健康相关环境问题提供有证据依据的邻域尺度回答。方法：我们使用 LangGraph 和 OpenAI large language models 开发了一条 agentic AI 管线，用于解释自然语言查询、选择并调用相关外部工具、检索实时环境数据和基于证据的健康指导，并综合生成回答。该管线整合了多个权威资源，包括天气预报、空气质量观测、地理空间服务，以及由哮喘相关临床指南构建的检索增强生成（RAG）模块。系统还包含外部服务不可用时提高稳健性的回退机制。我们使用一组经过整理、具有代表性的用户问题对管线进行评估，考察工具需求识别、正确工具选择、避免调用无关工具、参数映射、分析路径选择，以及将工具输出纳入最终回答的能力。结果：所开发系统成功将异质环境与健康信息源整合到统一的对话界面中，为 Salt Lake Valley 生成有证据依据的邻域尺度回答。在不同问题类型中，评估显示工具识别、参数映射和检索信息整合总体表现较强，支持该管线检索并整合可供普通民众使用的权威环境健康信息，并为暴露健康信息学转化路径的 T3 和 T4 阶段提供重要一步。结论：通过结合现有环境健康知识、局部传感器观测、邻域尺度环境测量，以及权威的州级和国家级天气与空气质量资源，该系统比仅依赖权威区域或州级信息的方法提供了更局部化、情境感知能力更强的指导。该管线不是依赖大语言模型的内部知识，而是动态检索、综合并标注来自权威来源的证据。模块化架构支持无缝整合更多环境数据流、健康知识源和地理区域，为未来转化管线提供可扩展基础，并完成从 T3 到 T4 的路径。
items.author_line: Ingebretsen, S. H., Gouripeddi, R., Facelli, J., Cummins, M., Shah-mohammadi, F.

items.title: FateDriver: Weakly supervised dual-view graph learning for transition-specific prioritization of candidate regulators in cellular reprogramming
items.abstract_or_text: Cellular reprogramming supports regenerative medicine, yet the endogenous regulators of a specified source-to-target transition remain incompletely defined. Existing computational methods rank candidate regulators from network topology, trajectory dynamics, or cell-state labels, leaving unused the factors experimentally delivered to induce the transition. We present FateDriver, a weakly supervised dual-view graph neural network that jointly represents cells and genes from single-cell transcriptomes, treats the delivered factors as sparse gene-level labels, and ranks the remaining genes for a specified transition under a positive--unlabeled formulation. Across two OSKM datasets and one GMT dataset, FateDriver ranked first or second among six methods in recovering externally curated reference genes, exceeded a supervision-matched non-graph model despite weaker co-expression with the delivered factors, and achieved the highest recovery of protein targets of pluripotency-inducing chemical cocktails in both OSKM datasets. Holding either the source or the endpoint fixed yielded distinct candidate programs, including a DDX58--interferon axis associated with cells lacking endogenous pluripotency markers. Applying the same framework to candidate source--target pairs prioritized distinct candidate origins for two in vivo partially reprogrammed intestinal populations. FateDriver converts sparse experimental knowledge into transition-specific hypotheses for regulator prioritization from single-cell trajectories.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】FateDriver 是一种弱监督双视图图神经网络，将单细胞转录组中的细胞和基因联合建模，并利用已递送诱导因子为稀疏标签，针对特定细胞重编程转变优先排序候选调控因子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在两个 OSKM 数据集和一个 GMT 数据集中，该方法在恢复外部整理的参考基因及化学诱导多能性相关蛋白靶点方面表现突出，并扩展到体内部分重编程肠道细胞群；结果仍主要用于候选假设生成。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞重编程支持再生医学，但特定来源到目标转变的内源性调控因子仍未被充分确定。现有计算方法从网络拓扑、轨迹动力学或细胞状态标签中对候选调控因子进行排序，却没有利用为诱导该转变而实验递送的因子。我们提出 FateDriver，这是一种弱监督双视图图神经网络，对单细胞转录组中的细胞和基因进行联合表示，将递送因子作为稀疏的基因层面标签，并在正例--未标记（positive--unlabeled）框架下，为指定转变对其余基因进行排序。在两个 OSKM 数据集和一个 GMT 数据集中，FateDriver 在恢复外部整理的参考基因方面位列六种方法的第一或第二；尽管与递送因子的共表达较弱，但其表现超过了监督程度匹配的非图模型；在两个 OSKM 数据集中，它对多能性诱导化学鸡尾酒的蛋白质靶点恢复率均为最高。固定来源或终点中的任一方会得到不同的候选程序，其中包括与缺乏内源性多能性标志物的细胞相关的 DDX58--干扰素轴。将同一框架应用于候选来源--目标细胞对时，为两个体内部分重编程的肠道细胞群优先确定了不同的候选起源。FateDriver 将稀疏的实验知识转化为基于单细胞轨迹进行调控因子优先排序的、特定转变的假设。
items.author_line: Sung, J., Son, K., Cha, H.-J., Kim, W., Lee, H.

items.title: Neural shape models enable cohort-scale simulation of knee cartilage mechanics
items.abstract_or_text: Knee osteoarthritis affects over 350 million people worldwide, is a leading cause of disability, and carries substantial costs. Cartilage mechanical load is believed to play a critical role in osteoarthritis pathophysiology, yet clinical biomechanics research uses external measures of joint loading that do not capture tissue-level load. We developed a fully-automated pipeline that builds biomechanical knee models from a single MRI using deep learning-based segmentation and neural shape models, and elastic foundation contact to simulate gait. Applied to 756 knees from the Osteoarthritis Initiative, each simulated under the same 10 standardized gaits, the pipeline converged in 99.6% of 7,560 simulations. Medial tibial pressure decreased from healthy to incident to mild osteoarthritis as disease-related shape changes enlarged contact area, an effect reproduced in simulations of synthetic knees. Yet within knees, medial cartilage thinned fastest over six years in regions of highest pressure, with stronger relationships in incident and mild osteoarthritis knees. Automated simulations provided cohort-scale, tissue-level support for mechanical theories of osteoarthritis progression and a framework for prospectively quantifying cartilage load to guide mechanical interventions.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】利用深度学习分割、神经形状模型和弹性基础接触模型，从单次 MRI 自动构建膝关节生物力学模型，并在 Osteoarthritis Initiative 的 756 个膝关节和 10 种标准步态下完成队列规模模拟。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 99.6% 的 7,560 次模拟成功收敛，并观察到组织压力与六年软骨变薄之间的关系，为骨关节炎进展的力学理论提供队列尺度、组织层面的支持；研究显示关联而非已证实的因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 膝骨关节炎影响全球超过 3.5 亿人，是导致残疾的主要原因，并带来巨大成本。软骨机械负荷被认为在骨关节炎病理生理学中发挥关键作用，但临床生物力学研究使用的关节外部负荷指标无法捕捉组织层面的负荷。我们开发了一条全自动管线，利用基于深度学习的分割、神经形状模型和弹性基础接触，从单次 MRI 构建生物力学膝关节模型并模拟步态。该管线应用于 Osteoarthritis Initiative 的 756 个膝关节，每个膝关节均在相同的 10 种标准化步态下进行模拟；7,560 次模拟中有 99.6% 收敛。随着疾病相关的形状变化扩大接触面积，从健康膝到发生骨关节炎再到轻度骨关节炎，内侧胫骨压力逐渐降低；在合成膝关节模拟中也重现了这一效应。然而，在同一个膝关节内，六年期间软骨变薄最快的区域是压力最高的区域，而且在发生骨关节炎和轻度骨关节炎膝中，这些关系更强。自动化模拟提供了队列规模、组织层面的证据，支持骨关节炎进展的机械理论，并为前瞻性量化软骨负荷、指导机械干预提供了框架。
items.author_line: Gatti, A. A., Marusich, K. R., Clouthier, A., White, M. S., Ong, C., Esrafilian, A., Smith, C., Kolesar, J., Tan, T., Uhlrich, S. D., Chu, C., Sherman, S. L., Gold, G. E., Delp, S. L., Kogan, F., Chaudhari, A. S.

items.title: Autonomous Hypothesis Testing Against Public Biomedical Data with Literature-Grounded Calibration
items.abstract_or_text: Public biomedical repositories contain petabytes of data, yet testing hypotheses against those resources still requires expert effort. I present a four-phase blinded workflow for autonomous computational hypothesis testing: an agent receives a natural-language hypothesis, discovers public datasets with academic publisher domains blocked, executes an analysis pipeline and validates findings against the literature. Published studies serve as calibration rulers, measuring how closely an autonomous workflow approaches known answers before it is trusted on unknown ones. Across five biomedical tasks spanning bacterial genomics, single-cell multiomics, metagenomics, cancer genomics and GWAS functional genomics, the agent scored 5–9 out of 10 on pre-specified rubrics in 20–188 minutes (the single-cell multiomics score was corrected from an initial 8 to 5 after blinded judge review identified over-credited criteria; see Methods). An exploratory comparison across three successive model generations found scores directionally higher for the first generation (claude-opus-4-6) on all five tasks (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 0.031, rank-biserial r = 1.0; n = 5 studies), with newer models completing tasks faster; the benchmark also exposed generation-specific safety policy and schema differences that silently confound cross-generation comparisons if not corrected. Failures fell into three categories, tool-version sensitivity, data-scope limitation and analytical completeness, all self-diagnosed by the validation phase in all five cases examined here without human prompting. These results introduce a calibration framework and failure taxonomy for characterising when autonomous computational science workflows should and should not be trusted.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】提出一个四阶段、盲法且以文献校准的自主计算假设检验流程，在五项生物医学任务中评估数据发现、分析执行和结果验证能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架把已发表研究作为校准尺，并明确暴露工具版本、数据范围和分析完整性失败模式；五项任务的 5–9/10 得分说明自主科研工作流仍需任务级验证。
items.abstract_zh: 公共生物医学数据库包含数 PB 级数据，但针对这些资源检验假设仍需要专家投入。我提出一个四阶段、盲法的自主计算假设检验工作流：代理接收一个自然语言假设，在屏蔽学术出版商域名的条件下发现公共数据集，执行分析管线，并根据文献验证结果。已发表研究被用作校准尺，用于衡量自主工作流接近已知答案的程度，然后才将其用于未知问题。在涵盖细菌基因组学、单细胞多组学、宏基因组学、癌症基因组学和 GWAS 功能基因组学的五项生物医学任务中，该代理在预先规定的评分标准上获得 5–9 分（满分 10 分），耗时 20–188 分钟（单细胞多组学得分因盲法评审发现标准被过度计分而从最初的 8 分修正为 5 分；见方法）。对三个连续模型世代进行的探索性比较显示，第一代（claude-opus-4-6）在全部五项任务中的得分方向性更高（单侧 Wilcoxon p = 0.031，秩二列相关 r = 1.0；n = 5 项研究），而较新的模型完成任务更快；该基准还暴露出不同世代之间的安全策略和模式差异，如果不加校正，会悄然混淆跨世代比较。失败分为三类：工具版本敏感性、数据范围限制和分析完整性；在所考察的全部五个案例中，验证阶段均能在无人提示的情况下自行诊断这些失败。这些结果提出了一个校准框架和失败分类法，用于描述自主计算科学工作流在何时可以、何时不应被信任。

items.title: Integrative systems biology identifies shared neuroimmune co-expression programmes across pulmonary tuberculosis and Alzheimer's disease
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background : There is growing evidence that pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) exerts long-lasting systemic effects on brain function, whereas Alzheimer's disease (AD) is increasingly recognized as a systemic neuroimmune disorder. BCG vaccination studies suggest that tuberculosis-associated immune pathways influence AD-related biology. However, whether PTB-associated co-expression programmes exhibit concordant activity in AD and display reproducible neuroanatomical organization within the human brain remains unknown. We hypothesized that PTB-associated co-expression programmes would exhibit concordant transcriptional activity in AD, retain aspects of their underlying co-expression architecture across diseases, and identify shared neuroimmune mechanisms relevant to chronic infection and neurodegeneration. We implemented an integrative systems biology framework combining whole-blood transcriptomics, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, functional enrichment, immune-cell deconvolution, and machine learning to identify PTB-associated co-expression programmes and prioritize biomarkers. These programmes were validated in two independent PTB cohorts, evaluated in an AD dataset, and mapped onto the Allen Human Brain Atlas to characterize neuroanatomical organization. Results: Active PTB was associated with widespread transcriptional remodeling, with 1,389 dysregulated genes organized into 16 PTB-associated co-expression modules. Nested machine learning identified a 12-gene biomarker signature that demonstrated excellent diagnostic performance in the discovery cohort (AUC ≈ 0.99) and retained performance in two independent external PTB datasets without model retraining. Majority of PTB-derived immune co-expression modules exhibited concordant activity in the independent AD cohort. Formal module-preservation analysis demonstrated that several PTB-derived networks retained moderate preservation in AD, supporting partial conservation of co-expression architecture across diseases. Brain transcriptomic mapping demonstrated reproducible region-specific organization across adult brain donors. Integrated neuroanatomical contextualization prioritized a subset of PTB-derived neuroimmune modules using cross-disease transcriptional activity, regional specificity, and inter-donor reproducibility, revealing neuroimmune transcriptional programmes shared across infection and neurodegeneration. Conclusions: Our findings establish a systems-level framework for investigating shared neuroimmune processes across chronic infection and neurodegeneration while identifying reproducible co-expression modules and candidate biomarkers for future studies.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】整合全血转录组、加权基因共表达网络分析、免疫细胞去卷积、功能富集和机器学习，寻找肺结核与 Alzheimer's disease 之间共享的神经免疫共表达程序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究在两个独立肺结核队列中验证 12 基因诊断特征，并在 Alzheimer's disease 数据中观察到部分网络保守性；这些结果支持共享机制假设，但不证明疾病间存在因果联系。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：越来越多的证据表明，肺结核（PTB）会对脑功能产生持久的全身性影响，而 Alzheimer's disease（AD）越来越被认为是一种全身性神经免疫疾病。BCG 疫苗研究提示，结核病相关免疫通路会影响 AD 相关生物学。然而，PTB 相关共表达程序是否在 AD 中表现出一致活性、并在人脑中显示可重复的神经解剖组织形式，仍然未知。我们假设，PTB 相关共表达程序在 AD 中会表现出一致的转录活性，在疾病之间保留其底层共表达架构的某些方面，并确定与慢性感染和神经变性相关的共享神经免疫机制。我们实施了一个整合系统生物学框架，结合全血转录组学、加权基因共表达网络分析、功能富集、免疫细胞去卷积和机器学习，以识别 PTB 相关共表达程序并优先确定生物标志物。这些程序在两个独立的 PTB 队列中得到验证，在一个 AD 数据集中进行评估，并映射到 Allen Human Brain Atlas 以刻画神经解剖组织。结果：活动性 PTB 与广泛的转录重塑相关，涉及 1,389 个失调基因，这些基因被组织成 16 个 PTB 相关共表达模块。嵌套机器学习确定了一个 12 基因生物标志物特征，在发现队列中表现出优异的诊断性能（AUC ≈ 0.99），并在两个独立外部 PTB 数据集中无需重新训练即保持性能。大多数 PTB 来源的免疫共表达模块在独立 AD 队列中表现出一致活性。正式的模块保留分析显示，若干 PTB 来源网络在 AD 中保留中等程度，支持不同疾病之间共表达架构部分保守。脑转录组映射显示，在成年脑供体之间存在可重复的区域特异性组织。综合神经解剖情境化分析依据跨疾病转录活性、区域特异性和供体间可重复性，优先确定了一组 PTB 来源的神经免疫模块，揭示了感染与神经变性之间共享的神经免疫转录程序。结论：我们的发现建立了一个系统层面的框架，用于研究慢性感染与神经变性之间共享的神经免疫过程，同时确定了可重复的共表达模块和供未来研究使用的候选生物标志物。
items.author_line: Taofeek OO, Adigun SA, Oladipo EK, Mushebenge AG, Khairallah A, Akinduti P, Sulaimon LA

items.title: CSF Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers in Relation to Functional Status and Tofersen Treatment Response in ALS
items.abstract_or_text: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease primarily affecting motor neurons but also frequently involving cognitive impairment. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) measurements of {beta} amyloid peptides (A{beta}40, A{beta}42), tau proteins, and neurofilaments are clinically established biomarkers in neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD). Emerging evidence suggests that AD-related pathological changes and AD-related biomarkers may appear in ALS, yet their diagnostic and prognostic significance remains unclear. In this retrospective study, we analyzed clinical and CSF biomarker data from patients with ALS, AD, Huntington's disease (HD), and other disease controls recruited in a real-world clinical setting. The dataset comprised A{beta}40, A{beta}42, total tau (t-Tau), phosphorylated tau181 (pTau181), phosphorylated neurofilament heavy chain (pNfH), and relevant serum markers. Additionally, longitudinal CSF sampling over one year was evaluated in three ALS patients receiving tofersen treatment. In this real-world cohort, AD-related CSF biomarkers demonstrated no diagnostic value for distinguishing ALS from other neurodegenerative conditions. However, A{beta}40, A{beta}42, and pTau181 levels correlated positively with ALS Functional Rating Scale (ALSFRS-R) global score and serum Creatine Kinase MB (CK-MB) concentrations. At the same time, a higher A{beta}42/A{beta}40 ratio was associated with better memory performance on the Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS). In tofersen-treated cases, AD-related biomarkers gradually declined during follow-up. These findings suggest that elevated CSF AD-associated biomarkers in ALS may reflect preserved functional and cognitive status and exhibited parallel declines during follow-up in three tofersen-treated patients, supporting their further prospective evaluation as exploratory markers of therapeutic responsiveness.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】在 ALS、AD、Huntington's disease 及其他对照的真实世界队列中分析 CSF 生物标志物，并评估 3 名接受 tofersen 治疗的 ALS 患者一年内的纵向变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提示 AD 相关 CSF 标志物与 ALS 功能和认知状态相关，但不能区分 ALS 与其他神经变性疾病；tofersen 相关下降仅来自 3 例患者，需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种主要影响运动神经元、但也经常累及认知功能的神经变性疾病。脑脊液（CSF）中的 {beta} 淀粉样蛋白肽（A{beta}40、A{beta}42）、tau 蛋白和神经丝是 Alzheimer's disease（AD）等神经变性疾病中临床已建立的生物标志物。新出现的证据表明，AD 相关病理变化和 AD 相关生物标志物可能出现在 ALS 中，但其诊断和预后意义仍不清楚。在这项回顾性研究中，我们分析了在真实世界临床环境中招募的 ALS、AD、Huntington's disease（HD）患者和其他疾病对照的临床及 CSF 生物标志物数据。数据集包括 A{beta}40、A{beta}42、总 tau（t-Tau）、磷酸化 tau181（pTau181）、磷酸化神经丝重链（pNfH）和相关血清标志物。此外，我们评估了 3 名接受 tofersen 治疗的 ALS 患者一年内的纵向 CSF 采样。在这个真实世界队列中，AD 相关 CSF 生物标志物对于区分 ALS 与其他神经变性疾病没有诊断价值。然而，A{beta}40、A{beta}42 和 pTau181 水平与 ALS 功能分级量表（ALSFRS-R）总分及血清肌酸激酶 MB（CK-MB）浓度呈正相关。同时，更高的 A{beta}42/A{beta}40 比值与 Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen（ECAS）中更好的记忆表现相关。在接受 tofersen 治疗的病例中，随访期间 AD 相关生物标志物逐渐下降。这些发现表明，ALS 中升高的 CSF AD 相关生物标志物可能反映较好的功能和认知状态，并且在 3 名接受 tofersen 治疗的患者中随访时同步下降，支持将其作为治疗反应探索性标志物进行进一步前瞻性评估。
items.author_line: Eberle, F., Bersen, S., Rachel, F., Widmann, C., Weydt, P., Castro Gomez, S.

items.title: A regenerative stem cell phenotype marked by ANXA1 defines aggressive colorectal cancer biology
items.abstract_or_text: Background: LGR5 and ANXA1 are markers for specific intestinal stem cell states. LGR5+/ANXA1- crypt base columnar cells (CBCs) maintain homeostasis, whereas ANXA1+/LGR5- regenerative stem cells (RSCs) are present in fetal and repairing epithelium. Both states have been described in colorectal cancer (CRC), yet their clinical significance remains unclear. We aimed to determine how ANXA1 and LGR5 expression relates to molecular subtype, immune microenvironment and outcome in CRC. Methods: Dual-colour in situ hybridisation for ANXA1 and LGR5 was performed on tissue microarrays from 2163 patients in the randomised SCOT trial (ISRCTN59757862). AI-based digital pathology quantified marker-positive area by compartment and image based consensus molecular subtype (imCMS). Markers were related to clinicopathological, molecular and immune data, and to survival using Kaplan-Meier and multivariable Cox analyses. Results: ANXA1 and LGR5 showed inverse enrichment among a diverse group of parameters. ANXA1 was highest in CMS1 and LGR5 in CMS2, with CMS3 and CMS4 being intermediate. ANXA1 dominance was associated with right-sidedness, mismatch repair deficiency, BRAF-V600E mutation, high stromal content, T4 stage, low stromal FoxP3 and high epithelial CD68 density. Combining both markers improved prognostic discrimination compared with either alone (cancer-specific survival p<0.001; recurrence-free interval p=0.004), with ANXA1 dominance remaining an independent predictor of recurrence after adjustment (HR 1.43, 95% CI 1.08-1.90, p=0.014). Conclusion: Relative ANXA1 enrichment defines an aggressive, stroma-rich, macrophage-enriched CRC subgroup with poor prognosis.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】在随机 SCOT 试验 2,163 名患者的组织微阵列上，利用 AI 数字病理定量 ANXA1 和 LGR5，并分析其与 CRC 分子亚型、免疫微环境和生存的关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大样本临床组织分析显示，相对 ANXA1 富集与基质丰富、巨噬细胞富集及较差预后相关；这是预后分层证据，不等同于 ANXA1 导致侵袭性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：LGR5 和 ANXA1 是特定肠道干细胞状态的标志物。LGR5+/ANXA1- 隐窝基底柱状细胞（CBCs）维持稳态，而 ANXA1+/LGR5- 再生干细胞（RSCs）存在于胎儿和修复中的上皮。两种状态都曾在结直肠癌（CRC）中被描述，但其临床意义仍不清楚。我们旨在确定 ANXA1 和 LGR5 表达与 CRC 分子亚型、免疫微环境和结局的关系。方法：在随机 SCOT 试验（ISRCTN59757862）的 2,163 名患者组织微阵列上，对 ANXA1 和 LGR5 进行双颜色原位杂交。基于 AI 的数字病理学按区室定量标志物阳性面积，并进行基于图像的共识分子亚型（imCMS）分析。随后将标志物与临床病理学、分子和免疫数据，以及 Kaplan-Meier 和多变量 Cox 分析中的生存联系起来。结果：在多种参数中，ANXA1 和 LGR5 呈相反富集。ANXA1 在 CMS1 中最高，LGR5 在 CMS2 中最高，CMS3 和 CMS4 居中。ANXA1 优势与右侧病变、错配修复缺陷、BRAF-V600E 突变、高基质含量、T4 期、低基质 FoxP3 密度和高上皮 CD68 密度相关。与单独使用任一标志物相比，将两者结合提高了预后区分能力（癌症特异性生存 p<0.001；无复发生存间期 p=0.004）；调整后 ANXA1 优势仍是复发的独立预测因子（HR 1.43，95% CI 1.08-1.90，p=0.014）。结论：相对 ANXA1 富集定义了一个具有侵袭性、富含基质和巨噬细胞的 CRC 亚组，并且该亚组预后较差。

items.title: Estimating glioblastoma migration-to-proliferation ratio from single time-point MRI data via radial density distribution
items.abstract_or_text: Glioblastoma (GBM) tumors with a high migration-to-proliferation ratio (D/k) are associated with treatment resistance, motivating the estimation of D/k from routine pre-treatment magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data and the investigation of mechanisms underlying its heterogeneity across patients. Unlike previous approaches based on nested spherical approximations of enhancing and non-enhancing tumor volumes, we incorporate the spatial arrangement of the enhancing and non-enhancing tumor regions by deriving a 1D tumor density distribution from their segmentations and fitting a 1D reaction-diffusion model to estimate D/k. We achieved an error of under 5% when comparing our method to synthetic density distributions and found excellent correlation with synthetic tumor segmentations (Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) = 0.996). We then evaluated associations between patient-specific D/k values and their clinical, transcriptomic, and radiomic features. When applied to 102 pre-treatment MRI scans from the Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) 2017 dataset, elevated D/k significantly correlated with reduced overall survival (log-rank p = 0.01), older age (p = 0.04), and a trend toward lower Karnofsky Performance Status (p = 0.059). In a subset of 91 patients with available microarray data, mesenchymal-like phenotypes consistently exhibited elevated D/k across three established molecular subtype classifications (p = 0.013, p = 0.055, and p = 0.127). Elastic Net regularization followed by overrepresentation analysis revealed an enrichment of glycosylation-related pathways among genes associated with D/k variability (p = 0.0123 and p = 0.0368). Furthermore, Multi-Omic Factor Analysis identified a radiomic factor correlated with D/k (r = 0.57, p = 4x10-9), with the highest-weighted features corresponding to smoothness of the non-enhancing tumor region on T2 and FLAIR.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】从单时间点 MRI 的增强与非增强肿瘤分割推导一维肿瘤密度分布，拟合一维反应--扩散模型估计胶质母细胞瘤迁移/增殖比 D/k。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在合成数据中误差低于 5%、与合成分割 PCC = 0.996，并在 102 例 BraTS 2017 MRI 中发现 D/k 与总生存及分子表型的统计关联；仍需外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 具有较高迁移/增殖比（D/k）的胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）与治疗耐药相关，因此促使研究者尝试从常规治疗前磁共振成像（MRI）数据估计 D/k，并研究其患者间异质性的机制。不同于以往基于增强和非增强肿瘤体积的嵌套球形近似方法，我们通过分割结果推导一维肿瘤密度分布，将增强和非增强肿瘤区域的空间排列纳入分析，并拟合一维反应--扩散模型来估计 D/k。将该方法与合成密度分布比较时，误差低于 5%；与合成肿瘤分割的相关性很高（Pearson 相关系数（PCC）= 0.996）。随后，我们评估了患者特异性 D/k 值与临床、转录组和影像组学特征之间的关联。在 Brain Tumor Segmentation（BraTS）2017 数据集的 102 次治疗前 MRI 扫描中，较高 D/k 与较短总生存显著相关（log-rank p = 0.01），也与年龄较大相关（p = 0.04），并呈现与较低 Karnofsky Performance Status 相关的趋势（p = 0.059）。在 91 名具有可用微阵列数据的患者子集中，间质样表型在三个既有分子亚型分类中均一致表现出较高 D/k（p = 0.013、p = 0.055 和 p = 0.127）。Elastic Net 正则化随后进行的过度代表性分析显示，与 D/k 变异相关的基因富集于糖基化相关通路（p = 0.0123 和 p = 0.0368）。此外，多组学因子分析确定了一个与 D/k 相关的影像组学因子（r = 0.57，p = 4x10-9）；权重最高的特征对应于 T2 和 FLAIR 上非增强肿瘤区域的平滑度。
items.author_line: Bravo, R. R., Hormuth, D. A., Lima, E. A. B. F., Tercan, B., Aguilar, B., Yankeelov, T. E.

items.title: Network analysis reveals converging molecular mechanisms in genetic epilepsies
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Rare genetic epilepsies are often difficult to diagnose and treat. They can arise from changes in many different genes, and the molecular basis linking these changes to epilepsy remains poorly understood. This complexity makes it difficult to select effective treatments and develop new therapies, leaving many patients with poorly controlled seizures and reduced quality of life Methods: To address this gap, we first identified epilepsy-associated genes and conducted a network-based analysis of biomolecular interactions in genetic epilepsy to identify converging pathways with high translational relevance and potential therapeutic targets. To run the analysis, we constructed a human brain-specific molecular interaction network by integrating all human pathways from the WikiPathways database. HotNet2 was then applied to identify highly perturbed clusters through evidence-based weight diffusion of EAGs in the human brain network. Results: We identified 2,496 epilepsy-associated genes (EAGs) from multiple resources. These genes encode coding for metabolite interconversion enzymes (20%), transporters (15%), and protein-modifying enzymes (11%). Furthermore, the network analysis identified 19 subnetworks with more than two nodes and 125 unique genes. Gene enrichment analysis revealed convergence of processes including action potential, synaptic function, nervous system development, TOR signaling, cilium organization, DNA repair, and cell fate specification. We identified 44 first-order neighbors connecting the subnetworks. By integrating drug-target interactions from DrugBank using CyTargetLinker, we highlighted potential therapeutic targets within the S4 subnetwork, associated with cerebral cortex development, as well as CREB1, a connector between subnetworks. Conclusion: Network analysis organized heterogeneous epilepsy-associated genes into biologically related subnetworks and generated hypotheses for further research.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】通过构建人脑特异性分子互作网络并应用 HotNet2，整合 2,496 个遗传性癫痫相关基因，识别收敛的分子亚网络和潜在药物靶点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将高度异质的遗传性癫痫基因组织到 19 个扰动亚网络和 125 个独特基因中，并用 DrugBank 互作数据提出 CREB1 等连接节点和候选靶点；结论主要是计算假设。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：罕见遗传性癫痫通常难以诊断和治疗。它们可能由许多不同基因的变化引起，而将这些变化与癫痫联系起来的分子基础仍未被充分理解。这种复杂性使得选择有效治疗和开发新疗法变得困难，许多患者因此癫痫发作控制不佳、生活质量下降。方法：为解决这一空白，我们首先识别癫痫相关基因，并对遗传性癫痫中的生物分子相互作用开展基于网络的分析，以识别具有高度转化相关性和潜在治疗靶点的收敛通路。为开展分析，我们整合 WikiPathways 数据库中的全部人类通路，构建了一个人脑特异性分子互作网络。随后，在该人脑网络中使用 HotNet2 对癫痫相关基因进行基于证据的权重扩散，以识别高度扰动的簇。结果：我们从多个资源中识别出 2,496 个癫痫相关基因（EAGs）。这些基因编码代谢物相互转化酶（20%）、转运体（15%）和蛋白质修饰酶（11%）。此外，网络分析识别出 19 个包含两个以上节点的亚网络，共涉及 125 个独特基因。基因富集分析显示，收敛过程包括动作电位、突触功能、神经系统发育、TOR 信号、纤毛组织、DNA 修复和细胞命运指定。我们还识别出连接这些亚网络的 44 个一级邻居。通过整合 DrugBank 的药物--靶点相互作用并使用 CyTargetLinker，我们突出显示了 S4 亚网络中与大脑皮层发育相关的潜在治疗靶点，以及连接多个亚网络的 CREB1。结论：网络分析将异质的癫痫相关基因组织成生物学相关的亚网络，并为进一步研究生成了假设。
items.author_line: Duan, Y., Valeanu, A., Rouhl, R. P. W., Vermeulen, J. R., de Kok, T. M., Ehrhart, F.

items.title: Sex-based differences in fibrosis markers in human abdominal aortic aneurysms
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) are a complex degenerative vascular disease. The role of fibrosis in AAA progression is unclear. Our study evaluated the impact of fibroblast activation protein (FAP), collagen, and vimentin on AAA fibrosis and progression. We hypothesized that FAP may influence fibrosis and disease severity in AAA, with potential sex-specific differences. Study Design: Multi-centered transcriptomic analysis of aortic samples from 15 human AAA and 5 non-AAA was performed to evaluate cell-specific fibrosis gene expression profiles. Histopathological and molecular analysis of 26 male and female AAA samples (mAAA and fAAA) and 29 male and female normal abdominal aortas (mNAA and fNAA) was performed to assess whole-tissue fibrosis markers and signaling. Results: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis identified eight major cell clusters with distinct sex-based distributions. Although vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) and fibroblast clusters had reduced counts in both male and female AAAs, they more highly expressed FAP and COL1A1 genes, particularly in females. Whole-tissue analysis demonstrated elevated extracellular matrix deposits with markedly increased collagen type 1 in both mAAA and fAAA. Alpha-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA)-positive VSMCs were also reduced in mAAA and fAAA, but FAP was notably elevated, and robustly in fAAA. FAP-positive fibroblasts in fAAA exhibited increased expression of fibrosis markers, suggesting a unique pro-fibrotic phenotype. Conclusion: Our study reveals a sex-based difference in AAA tissue, with elevated fibrosis markers and increased FAP levels in females, suggesting its significant role in disease progression. These findings underscore the potential of FAP as a unique tissue biomarker for AAAs and warrants further investigation into novel targeted therapies that aim to stabilize AAAs, particularly in female patients.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】对 15 例 AAA 和 5 例非 AAA 主动脉样本进行转录组分析，并结合 26 例男性/女性 AAA 与 29 例正常主动脉的组织学和分子分析，评估性别差异及 FAP 相关纤维化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示女性 AAA 组织中 FAP 和纤维化标志物更高，支持 FAP 作为性别特异性组织生物标志物的进一步研究；目前仍是观察性关联。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：腹主动脉瘤（AAA）是一种复杂的退行性血管疾病。纤维化在 AAA 进展中的作用尚不清楚。本研究评估成纤维细胞活化蛋白（FAP）、胶原蛋白和波形蛋白对 AAA 纤维化和进展的影响。我们假设 FAP 可能影响 AAA 的纤维化和疾病严重程度，并存在潜在的性别特异性差异。研究设计：对 15 例人 AAA 和 5 例非 AAA 主动脉样本进行多中心转录组分析，以评估细胞特异性纤维化基因表达谱。对 26 份男性和女性 AAA 样本（mAAA 和 fAAA）以及 29 份男性和女性正常腹主动脉样本（mNAA 和 fNAA）进行组织病理学和分子分析，以评估全组织纤维化标志物及信号传导。结果：单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）分析识别出 8 个主要细胞簇，并显示其性别分布不同。尽管男性和女性 AAA 中血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）及成纤维细胞簇的数量都减少，但它们表达更高的 FAP 和 COL1A1 基因，尤其是在女性中。全组织分析显示，mAAA 和 fAAA 中细胞外基质沉积均增加，I 型胶原蛋白显著升高。mAAA 和 fAAA 中 α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（α-SMA）阳性 VSMCs 也减少，但 FAP 明显升高，且在 fAAA 中升高更为显著。fAAA 中 FAP 阳性成纤维细胞表达更高水平的纤维化标志物，提示一种独特的促纤维化表型。结论：本研究揭示 AAA 组织存在性别差异，女性中纤维化标志物和 FAP 水平升高，提示其可能在疾病进展中发挥重要作用，并支持将 FAP 作为 AAA 独特组织生物标志物的进一步研究，尤其是面向女性患者的靶向治疗。
items.author_line: Elizondo Benedetto S, Wahidi R, Arif B, Rusconi B, Braasch MC, Ibrahim D, Zaghloul M, Soltan O, Engles N, Kuziez I, Ohman W, Sanchez LA, Zayed MA

items.title: Representation learning of somatic missense mutation landscapes across cancer types
items.abstract_or_text: Somatic missense mutations are pervasive in cancer genomes, yet existing studies have largely compressed them into mutation burden, mutation signatures, or driver gene annotations. Such representations obscure mutation-specific context and higher-order dependencies, leaving the latent biological structure of somatic mutation landscapes insufficiently characterized by systematic, data-driven approaches. Here we present MMRL, a pan-cancer Missense Mutation Representation Learning framework that learns the representations directly from somatic missense mutation profiles. By integrating mutation-associated features including gene identity, trinucleotide context, AlphaMissense pathogenicity, amino acid substitution and protein positional information, MMRL uses self-supervised learning to capture higher-order patterns among missense mutations across ~50,000 tumor samples from diverse cancer types. Across three pan-cancer cohorts, MMRL embeddings consistently achieved higher cross-validated prognostic discrimination than TMB and remained significantly associated with overall survival after adjustment for cancer type and TMB, as well as age where available. This prognostic value was also observed among patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors. Unsupervised clustering analysis of MMRL embeddings identified nine mutation subtypes in the TCGA pan-cancer cohort, with distinct survival outcomes, cancer-type compositions and mutational signature profiles, indicating that the learned embedding space captured clinically and biologically meaningful structure. Attention-based analyses further indicated that MMRL captured context-dependent mutation patterns beyond mutation frequency and predicted pathogenicity. Together, MMRL provides a data-driven strategy for decoding somatic missense mutation landscape and may facilitate precision oncology.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】MMRL 将基因身份、三核苷酸背景、AlphaMissense 致病性、氨基酸替换和蛋白质位置等特征输入自监督表示学习框架，覆盖约 50,000 个肿瘤样本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在三个泛癌队列中，MMRL 嵌入的预后区分能力高于 TMB，并在免疫检查点抑制剂治疗人群中保持关联；该结果支持精确肿瘤学应用潜力，但仍需独立前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 体细胞错义突变广泛存在于癌症基因组中，但现有研究大多将其压缩为突变负荷、突变特征或驱动基因注释。这类表示方式掩盖了突变特异性背景和高阶依赖关系，使体细胞突变景观中的潜在生物学结构仍缺乏系统、数据驱动的刻画。在此，我们提出 MMRL，即泛癌 Missense Mutation Representation Learning 框架，直接从体细胞错义突变谱中学习表示。MMRL 整合了与突变相关的特征，包括基因身份、三核苷酸背景、AlphaMissense 致病性、氨基酸替换和蛋白质位置等信息，并利用自监督学习从来自不同癌症类型的约 50,000 个肿瘤样本中捕捉错义突变之间的高阶模式。在三个泛癌队列中，与 TMB 相比，MMRL 嵌入持续获得更高的交叉验证预后区分能力；在校正癌症类型和 TMB，以及在可获得时校正年龄后，MMRL 仍与总生存显著相关。在接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗的患者中也观察到这种预后价值。对 TCGA 泛癌队列中的 MMRL 嵌入进行无监督聚类，识别出 9 个突变亚型，这些亚型具有不同的生存结局、癌症类型构成和突变特征谱，表明学习到的嵌入空间捕捉了具有临床和生物学意义的结构。基于注意力的分析进一步表明，MMRL 捕捉到了超越突变频率和预测致病性的、依赖背景的突变模式。总体而言，MMRL 提供了一种解码体细胞错义突变景观的数据驱动策略，并可能促进精准肿瘤学。
items.author_line: Wang, Z.-L., Cai, M., Li, Z., Lin, Z., Yin, Y., Chen, Z., Yan, H., Quan, Z., Liao, J.-Y., Zheng, Y.
